name: Real-time clock (DS3231)
author: Bench Workshop
description: The DS3231 clock module: it keeps the date and time (starting from this PC's clock when the run starts, and running with the simulation: pausing pauses it) and has a thermometer. I2C at 0x68 (the same as an MPU-6050: they can't share a bus). Includes RTClib.h.

parts.name: Clock (DS3231 module)
parts.description: Keeps the time with its coin cell, even with the board off. VCC (3.3-5 V), GND, SDA, SCL (SQW: a 1 Hz square wave if asked). #include <RTClib.h>; RTC_DS3231 rtc; rtc.begin(); DateTime now = rtc.now(); now.hour()... Set it once with rtc.adjust(DateTime(F(__DATE__), F(__TIME__)));

examples.name: Clock and thermometer
examples.description: A board reads the clock every second and prints the date, the time and the temperature. Press Run and open the board's serial monitor.
